snippet.title: Sushi Cat Legacy Collection: A Purr-fect Feast of Feline Fun
snippet.description:
Now Available on Steam @ https://armor.ag/SC-LC

Meowza! Welcome to the launch of Sushi Cat Legacy Collection; the ultimate bundle for every sushi-loving kitty (and human!) out there.

From the original classic of chasing sushi rolls, to wild purr-ades, cat-apults & honeymoon adventures, our chonky feline hero is back and hungrier than ever!

What’s included:
• All your fav-furite Sushi Cat titles rolled into one legacy collection; including Sushi Cat, Sushi Cat 2, Sushi Cat The Great Purrade, Sushi Cat The Honeymoon and Sushi Catapult! 
• Tons of colorful, cartoony & family-friendly fun (perfect for players of all ages). 
• A purr-fect way to dive into the world of cute cats and sushi; no fishy business.

Don’t forget to:
– Hit that Like button if you're feline good today!
– Subscribe for more tail-flicking updates

Thanks for joining our cat-crew! Grab your sushi, warm up your whiskers, and let’s leap into legacy together.
#SushiCat #CatGame #LegacyCollection #ArmorGamesStudios
